purchase.description: Captures completed transactions with full order details including transaction ID, items array, monetary value, currency, fulfillment method, payment type, store and shipping context, and customer attributes.

user_engagement.description: Records generic user engagement interactions within a session with user identification to track activity.

session_start.description: Fires when a new user session begins, identified by session ID.

view_item.description: Records product page views with item details, pricing, availability status, store location context, and fulfillment options for BOPIS and in-store fulfillment tracking.

search.description: Fires when customers perform search queries with geographic parameters, result counts, and fulfillment context, primarily for store locator searches.

view_search_results.description: Captures when search results are displayed following an internal or external search query with results count.

page_view.description: Records every page load with full URL, path, referrer, and page hierarchy information for traffic and navigation analysis.

sign_up.description: Records new account creation with registration method, provider, and conversion context from guest or existing user sessions.

retention_measurement.description: Fires at cohort boundaries to mark first-activity dates and return behaviors within defined retention windows for cohort analysis.

add_shipping_info.description: Records checkout stage events when customers select fulfillment method and shipping options, including pickup location, delivery window, and order summary.
